title: Shadow Scissors v2 — runners with escort screens
intro: Outcome-labelled six-cell exhibition of the same Tapline outer-route question. Each four-body wing now has one Core runner and three screen bodies: the screen trails its runner during the latched breach, then denies the enemy home-to-Well exit. A corrected allocator enforces the authored two-bodies-per-Core cap across target fallbacks. This is an exhibit, not a balance measurement.

cards.opponent: tapline-mid-rush-control-v1 — all eight bodies take the shorter middle pressure line
cards.trigger: One runner and at least two screen bodies from each wing reach their rear rally zones.
cards.tactic: Both outer wings latch the breach; each screen trails its runner through contact while the runner claims the enemy-side Core and returns directly.
cards.counterplay: The direct pack banks the centre Core first, contests the return corridor, and can kill a runner before its trailing screen establishes fire.
cards.fallback: After 80 breach ticks, runners alone collect known loose Cores while all six screens fight and hold the enemy home-to-Well exit.
cards.watch: Watch t0–160: full perimeter travel, joint breach, runner pickup, trailing screen, and whether the first captured Core reaches home. Around t150, verify no Core attracts more than two explicit collectors.
